v1.name: ProtTox-3DKD v1
v1.oof_comparator: mlp_teacher_kd dual-seed fold ensemble OOF (v1 fold-base)

architecture.name: Uncertainty-Gated Privileged Refinement
architecture.shared_representation: Frozen ProtT5 TriStat + 9 PhysChem -> shared MLP projection (192d)
architecture.privileged_head: shared -> z_priv; receives BCE(label) and teacher KD during training
architecture.gate: g = 1 - 2*|sigmoid(z_base) - 0.5|, clipped to [0,1], detached for loss weighting

arms.B: same params, no uncertainty gate (fixed g=0.5), global KD to z_priv
arms.C: same params, uncertainty gate, no teacher KD
arms.D: same params, uncertainty gate, teacher KD weighted by g on z_priv
